en-US.title: Venture: History Nearby
en-US.subtitle: The history all around you
en-US.promoText: Wherever you stand you are surrounded by history. Venture makes all of it visible in seconds: the famous, the forgotten, and the stories you never knew were there.
en-US.description:
Wherever you stand, you are standing on stories. Venture finds them.

Open the app and there they are: a map of the history within a walk of you, your own position among the pins, and the closest stories first, each with a photograph. Tap one and Venture tells it to you — about a minute, written by the app for that one place, to read or to listen to while you carry on walking. No searching, no setting up, no account.

Then find out how much of it you actually know. Venture sets a quiz on the area you are standing in — different questions in every neighborhood, each one pointing back at the place it came from. The last question has no options at all: it names somewhere a few minutes away and asks which way it is. You answer by turning until the phone agrees.

Towns and neighborhoods get the long version: an original account in chapters, with a timeline of what happened on that ground and how the places around you relate.

Add the widget and your Home Screen counts the stories around you as you move through the day.

When something catches your eye, go: a live compass needle, or turn-by-turn walking directions. Keep whatever you like and it works without a signal. Or look a place up before you go — the city you are visiting next month, the street you grew up on.

• A live map of the history within a walk, your position among the pins
• A telling of about a minute for every place, written by the app, to read or to listen to
• A quiz about the ground you are standing on — ending with a question you answer by pointing the phone
• Long reads in chapters, with timelines, for towns and neighborhoods
• Compass and turn-by-turn walking directions to anything you pick
• A Home Screen widget counting the stories around you
• Saved stories work offline
• No account, no ads, nothing following you around

Venture writes its tellings from open records — Wikipedia, Historic England, Open Plaques, Geograph — and cites them beneath each story. It uses your location for one thing: finding the history near you. No account, no tracking, no location history.
